units.source_text: 这正是千重子兴致勃勃的时候。

en.t: This was just when Chieko was full of excitement.

units.source_text: 幽暗的大雄宝殿已经点上了明灯。

en.t: In the dim main hall, the lamps had already been lit.

units.source_text: 千重子没在正殿的舞台上停步，径直走过去。

en.t: Chieko did not stop on the stage of the main hall, but walked straight past.

units.source_text: 经过阿弥陀堂前，一直走到了后院。

en.t: She passed in front of the Amida Hall and went all the way to the rear garden.
